save.failed.title: The calendar could not be saved
save.failed.text: Your latest changes are not on disk yet: {reason}. The whole calendar is saved again after the next change. If the problem remains, closing the program loses those changes.
backup.restore.failed.title: The backup could not be restored
backup.restore.failed.text: The selected backup is damaged, missing or was written by a newer version of the program. Your current calendar was not changed.
archive.export.title: Save a backup of the whole application
archive.export.done.title: The backup was saved
archive.export.done.text: The calendar and the settings were saved to: {path}
archive.export.failed.title: The backup could not be saved
archive.import.title: Choose the backup file of the whole application
archive.import.confirm: Your current calendar and settings will be replaced by the ones from the selected backup.
archive.import.done.title: The backup was restored
archive.import.done.text: The calendar and the settings were restored from the backup.
archive.import.failed.title: The backup could not be restored
archive.import.failed.notAnArchive: The selected file is not an application backup. Your current calendar was not changed.
archive.import.failed.wrongApplication: This backup belongs to a different application. Your current calendar was not changed.
archive.import.failed.unsupported: The backup was written by a newer version of the program. Your current calendar was not changed.
archive.import.failed.corrupted: The backup file is damaged. Your current calendar was not changed.
archive.import.failed.io: The backup cannot be read: {reason}. Your current calendar was not changed.
cloud.apiKeyExpiring.title: API key expires soon
dialog.disconnect.title: Disconnect from cloud
dialog.disconnect.message: The cloud address, the API key and the encryption passphrase will be removed from this computer and synchronization will stop. Your calendar on this computer and in the cloud stays as it is.
sync.problem.title: The cloud could not be synchronized
sync.problem.authRejected: The cloud rejected the API key, so your changes are not being sent. Your calendar is safe on this computer. Create a new key in the cloud panel and enter it in File → Connect to cloud.
sync.problem.decryptionFailed: The calendar in the cloud cannot be decrypted with the passphrase saved on this computer, so it is neither read nor changed. Enter the passphrase used on your other devices in File → Connect to cloud. Your calendar on this computer is not affected.
sync.problem.documentTooLarge: The calendar for {year} is too large for the cloud server and cannot be sent. It stays on this computer.
sync.discarded.title: A change was replaced
sync.discarded.text: A change you made in {year} while it was being synchronized was replaced by a newer version from the cloud. The earlier version is available in File → Restore from backup…
cloud.secretsInConfigFile: No system keyring is available, so the API key and the encryption passphrase are kept in the configuration file of the application. Keep your user account and your disk protected.
cloud.keyring.title: The saved cloud key cannot be read
cloud.keyring.text: The system keyring could not be read, so the API key and the encryption passphrase saved for the cloud are not available and the calendar is not synchronized. Unlock the keyring and restart the application, or enter the key again in File → Connect to cloud. Your calendar on this computer is not affected.
